method: Opus readers (print + WG raw ops + every carrier) each followed by an adversarial verifier; findings applied by 3 family spec(s), verdicts derived by scripts/wg-batch-close.mjs from the cited rows, edits, tests and teaches

confirmed.summary: The apparition's avatar form (Cosmic Notary) reaches the player only as prose in the apparition's description; WG writes the form onto the Avatar spell itself through the apparition's Primary mode, so a 19th-level animist casting avatar thr

The feat prints that you learn the zombie horde grave spell, but our record has no focusSpells (or any spell-grant field), so the player never gets the focus spell; WG grants it and the flag is a real gap, not a misread.
Ours never grants the Azlanti language the background prints; WG delivers it with giveLanguage, so a player picking this background is missing a known language.
Ours omits the Azlant Lore training the background prints (trainedLore absent), which WG delivers via createValue; the comparer's flag named only 'language' and missed it.
Defensive Automaton carries no ancestryHp, so the character keeps the automaton chassis's 8 ancestry HP where print (and WG) give 10.
Defensive Automaton does not grant the Toughness feat that print and WG both grant (real gap, not an instrument misread).
Newly Minted Automaton does not grant the Additional Lore feat (lore of the player's choice) that print and WG both grant.
Newly Minted Automaton gives no bonus language slot where print (and WG's LANGUAGE select) give one.
